tools.name: create_report
tools.description:
Create a Maps Census report: counts of Google Maps places for business types in a zone, with optional filters, rows split by one dimension and a measure in columns. Returns the report URL at once; call get_report for the figures.
Each row costs one count, plus one per column (two for a share).

types.description: Business types: slugs ("dentist") or names in the report language ("Dentiste"). Omit for all businesses.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "FR" or "US".

admin1.description: Region or state, by name ("Île-de-France", "California") or code ("11", "CA").

admin2.description: Department or county, by name or code. In the United States, give admin1 too.

gmap_is_main_type.description: true: only places whose main type is one of the types; false: only places where it is a secondary type.

gmap_is_closed.description: true: only places marked permanently closed; false: only places not marked closed.

gmap_has_website.description: true: only places with a website; false: only places without one.

gmap_has_phone.description: true: only places with a phone number; false: only places without one.

website_has_emails.description: true: only places whose website shows an email; false: only places whose website shows none.

gmap_phone_type.description: Only places with this phone type; not in US, CA, DO, PR, MX, CL, DK, where landline and mobile numbers cannot be told apart.

gmap_first_seen_at_gte.description: Only places first indexed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

gmap_first_seen_at_lte.description: Only places first indexed on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

breakdown.description: How the rows split the set: none (one row), type (one row per type, two types at least), location (one row per zone, see location_level), rating, reviews or phone (one row per band; phone not in US, CA, DO, PR, MX, CL, DK, where landline and mobile numbers cannot be told apart), indicator (one row per indicator). Default: none.

location_level.description: Zone level of the rows when breakdown is location. Default: the level just under the zone.

columns.description: What the columns show: indicator (the share of each row with each indicator), type, rating, reviews or phone (a cross table; phone not in US, CA, DO, PR, MX, CL, DK, where landline and mobile numbers cannot be told apart), none (the count only). Default: indicator, or none when breakdown is indicator.

measure.description: For a cross table: count (places per cell) or share (the share of each cell with share_indicator). Default: count.

share_indicator.description: The indicator a share measure counts.

indicators.description: Indicators of indicator rows or columns, 12 at most. Default: website, email, phone, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, less the filters given.

charts.description: Charts on the report page, above its table. Default: bars.

title.description: Report title, 120 characters at most. Default: built from the types and the zone.

locale.description: Language of the report, its labels and its URL. Default: en.

full_report.description: true only when the user asks for a written report, a PDF or a page to share: the report then gets a written analysis and a PDF, a minute or two after the counts. Leave it false when the user only wants figures. Default: false.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get a Maps Census report. Once ready: its title, criteria, table (a header line, then one line per group; raw counts, with the legend's marks for hidden figures) and key points, plus the PDF URL for a full report. Until then: the status and when to retry. The status is counting, then for a full report writing (the written analysis) and pdf (the PDF being built), then ready.

report_id.description: The report_id create_report returned, also the last part of the report URL.
